description: HushPinterest v0.0.11: 29 patches for Pinterest 14.40.0, which needs Android 10 or newer. New in this release: Hide AI-labeled pins works again on Pinterest 14.40.0, which marks AI pins in a new way. Validation: 948 runtime tests passed. All 221 patch tests passed. All 29 patches applied without forcing to Pinterest 14.40.0. Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. Uninstall the stock app first, then sign in with your email and a Pinterest password.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Paints the bottom bar pure black in dark mode, so it matches Pinterest's black pages on OLED screens. The comments sheet and a pin's menu can go black too, each with its own switch. Light mode stays as it is. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Pinterest from sending usage reports, crash reports and ad-tracking data to outside companies, and turns off Google's analytics inside the app. Good if you'd rather share less. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable update nag
patches.description: Stops Pinterest's pop-ups asking you to update from the Play Store. You can still update Pinterest yourself. Good if the reminders get annoying. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Updates.

patches.name: Download board
patches.description: Adds Download board to a board's menu. It saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board, up to 500, and skips ones already in Download history, so you can keep a board without picking pins one at a time. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: Download pins
patches.description: Adds downloads for a pin, or for several pins you select in a grid. Saves the original image or the highest-quality video Pinterest supplies to your phone. When it saves an image, Pinterest's own Download image row is hidden. Downloads go to the Download folder. Turn on Save in Pinterest's folder to keep them in Pictures/100PINT/Pins with Pinterest's own saves, or use Pick a download folder to choose any folder inside Pictures, DCIM, Download or Documents. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: Filter pin menu
patches.description: Lets you hide Add to collage, Remix collage, Search image and Promote pin in a pin's menu, each with its own switch. Download, share and copy link stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Fix push notifications
patches.description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Google's Firebase service only signs Pinterest up when the request names Pinterest's original signature, so this sends that signature's fingerprint and changes nothing else in the request. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Hide AI-labeled pins
patches.description: Removes pins that Pinterest labels as made or changed with AI from your home feed, search, related pins and boards. AI images without the label still show. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes promoted pins from your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides panels that only hold ads. Good for a cleaner feed. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide advertising ID
patches.description: Pinterest sees an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same as if you deleted your advertising ID in Android. Pinterest also stops keeping its browser ID in Google's Block Store, so a reinstall doesn't bring the old one back. Good for keeping ads from following you. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide closeup buttons
patches.description: Lets you hide the back arrow and the visual search (lens) button that float over a pin you open, each with its own switch, so they stop covering the picture. Your phone's back gesture still leaves the pin, and Search image in the pin menu still works. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide comments
patches.description: Collapses the comments and comment previews under pins. It doesn't change who can comment on your pins. Good for a quieter pin page. A separate switch hides the suggested replies next to the comment box. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide header buttons
patches.description: Hides the small icon buttons at the end of the top bar. Back buttons, text buttons and account controls stay. Good for a cleaner top bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Lets you hide the Create, Notifications and Search buttons in the bottom bar, each with its own switch. Home and Profile stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide save toasts
patches.description: Stops the pop-up Pinterest shows after you save a pin, such as the Saved to your board message or a suggestion to follow the creator. The pin is still saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide search history
patches.description: Hides your recent searches on the search screen of this phone. It doesn't delete your account's search history. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide shopping and product pins
patches.description: Hides shoppable pins, shopping stories and featured boards. Good if you want to browse ideas, not products. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide survey prompts
patches.description: Turns down Pinterest's "Got a minute?" survey invite before it pops up, the same way tapping Maybe later does, so the same survey doesn't come back. Advertiser-sponsored polls don't pop up either. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide topic suggestions
patches.description: Hides the Ideas you might love row of topic bubbles under pins, without leaving a gap. Comments and related pins stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: HushPinterest settings
patches.description: Adds a HushPinterest page to Pinterest where you turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Pinterest's settings, or by long-pressing the Pinterest logo at the top of your home feed or Pinterest's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Long-press download
patches.description: Adds a Download button to the round menu you get when you long-press a pin in a grid, so you can save a pin without opening it. Slide onto the button and let go. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: No screenshot share menu
patches.description: Stops Pinterest from popping up sharing suggestions after you take a screenshot. Screenshots still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Open links in your browser
patches.description: Opens a pin's Visit link and profile websites in your web browser. Pinterest links and sign-in work as before. Good if you prefer your own browser. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Links.

patches.name: Original-quality images
patches.description: Loads the original image for each pin and in collages, instead of the large size. Pictures look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Quiet email reminders
patches.description: Dismisses the optional reminder to confirm your email. Account checks and sign-in still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches.description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Pinterest, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in
patches.description: Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Pinterest's original signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Strip link tracking
patches.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Pinterest. The link still goes to the same place. Its Plain pin links switch also turns short pin.it links into the pin's own pinterest.com link, so they don't show who shared them. Strip link tracking is on by default and Plain pin links starts off. Both are in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: System share sheet
patches.description: Uses Android's own share menu when you share a pin link. Screenshot and download actions work as before. Good if you want your usual share targets. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

release_notes:
HushPinterest 0.0.9 has 29 patches for Pinterest 14.40.0. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. HushPinterest now has its own row in Pinterest's Settings list, and its settings can show in English while Pinterest stays in your language. Black bottom bar reaches the buttons that stayed gray, AMOLED black adds Black comments and Black pin menu, and Hide save toasts catches confirmations it used to let through.

This release moves to Pinterest 14.40.0, the newest version. Patch 14.40.0 and install it over your current HushPinterest with the same signing key, and your settings stay as they are.

## What's new

- HushPinterest now patches Pinterest 14.40.0, the newest release, in place of 14.39.0. Download pins, Long-press download, Hide topic suggestions and Open links in your browser couldn't find their spots in the new build until they were updated. Hide closeup buttons still hides the lens on both pin screens, though 14.40.0 builds one of those lenses differently.
- When a Quick setup can't change some of its switches, you now get one short message that says how many changed and how many didn't. Before, each of those switches could show a message of its own and crowd out the summary, and the summary itself ran past the two lines a message gets.
- A switch that needs a restart could have trouble saving on its way back to its starting value and still end up there. The restart row kept counting it anyway, and the next time you flipped that switch it could snap back. Now the row's count is right and the switch stays where you put it.
- With a screen reader on, the settings screen now reads how many changes are waiting for a restart whenever that number changes, and reads the result of a Check now you tapped. Each is read once, after whatever is already being read, and focus stays where it was. The daily check that runs on its own stays quiet.
- Quick setups now counts only the switches that really changed. If one can't be changed, the message also says how many were left as they were, and whether the page already shows their saved values or needs opening again first.
- More settings is now a heading on the settings home page, with its six pages listed under it from Links to About. Every page is one tap from home and Back always goes home. Report a problem and Support HushPinterest are still the last two rows. Patch descriptions and the bug report form point to the shorter paths.
- HushPinterest can show its own settings, menus and messages in English while Pinterest stays in your language. Tap HushPinterest language on the Pause, backup and diagnostics page and pick English. The screen changes right away with no restart, and Same as Pinterest switches it back. The choice works while HushPinterest is paused and isn't written to exported settings files.
- Hide header buttons keeps the Settings gear in Saved visible, including when Pinterest uses another language. Optional icons still hide, and turning the switch off or pausing restores them.
- HushPinterest has its own row in Pinterest's Settings list. It opens while HushPinterest is paused and works alongside the Morphe settings entry. The logo long press, app shortcut and App info entry still work.
- Original-image searches now share a 10-second deadline, including connection setup and slow headers. Short-link HEAD requests also stop at their deadline. A stalled host keeps the supplied image or clipboard text, and repeated attempts can't create unlimited network workers.
- Save list can write a bookmarks file now. Tap Save list in Download visible pins or Download board and pick Bookmarks file (HTML) or JSON file. The bookmarks file opens in any browser and imports into browsers and bookmark apps, with each pin as a bookmark and its source link in the description. It follows the JSON list's rules: only the pins you chose or the board had loaded, no account details or media addresses, and a source link is left out when it can't be kept exactly as given. The JSON list is unchanged.
- When a change needs Pinterest to restart, a Restart row shows up near the top of the settings page right away and counts the changes waiting. Tapping it closes Pinterest and reopens it on the same settings page. The old line that only said a restart was needed is gone.
- Disable analytics, Hide screenshot share and Fix push notifications now bring up the Restart row when you flip them, since each one takes effect on Pinterest's next start.
- Report a problem sits just above Support HushPinterest on the settings home. It opens GitHub's bug form with your HushPinterest and Pinterest versions, your phone model, its Android version and the switches you have on already filled in, and leaves room for what happened and what you expected. Nothing is sent until you submit it on GitHub.
- Quick setups on the settings home turns on the Quiet or Privacy switches in one tap, or puts every feature switch back the way it started. A message says how many settings it changed.
- Settings search, buttons and choices have clearer focus outlines and consistent control borders. Back and Clear search also have labels when you hover or hold them.
- Settings summaries are shorter, with the same restart and download limits explained in all five translations. Switches use squared corners, and Licenses and a no-change import preview close with Close.
- Download board keeps its explanation above the choices, so large text doesn't squeeze out the actions. Download history explains why finished files can't be opened while downloads are off or paused, and no longer suggests getting a fresh link for a finished download.
- Settings opens again from Android's App info page or the launcher shortcut when Pinterest's home screen is already running. Those requests used to miss the settings hook on that screen.
- Hide save toasts now catches the confirmations it used to let through. Two are Pinterest's own toasts: the Saved to your board message with a "Tap here to discover more ideas" line, which Pinterest swaps in from your third save in a row to the same board, and the board picker's Saved to message when you save to several boards or to your profile. The others are worded on the spot by the screen that saves the pin. That's the Saved to section message, and the plain Android pop-up Pinterest uses in a few places, such as a save from another app's share sheet. Those are picked out by their text in whatever language Pinterest is showing, so a moved pin, a new section, an error or a removal still gets its message. With Debug logging on, the log names every toast Pinterest shows and says whether it was hidden, and it notes each Android pop-up from a save screen without its text.
- Black bottom bar now paints the bar's buttons in the layouts where they stayed gray. That covers frosted glass buttons and the search pill, plus any button Pinterest rebuilds after the bar first appears. The search pill turns black on phones that show it see-through instead of frosted too. Icons, outlines and the selected marker keep their colors, and Pinterest's gray comes back when the switch is off, HushPinterest is paused or the phone is in light mode.
- AMOLED black has two new switches on the Interface page, Black comments and Black pin menu. In dark mode, Black comments paints the comments sheet and its reply bar pure black, and Black pin menu does the same for a pin's menu. While either one is open, the strip behind the gesture bar at the bottom of the screen is black too, so the sheet doesn't end in a gray band. Both start off. Text and icons keep their colors, and so do the divider lines. Pinterest's gray comes back when a switch is off or HushPinterest is paused, and light mode is left alone.
- The band along the bottom edge, behind the navigation buttons or gesture handle, now stays black with Black bottom bar, Black comments and Black pin menu. On phones with the three navigation buttons, Pinterest gives that band its page's gray twice over, once on its own strip and once on the window behind the buttons, so a black bar or sheet still ended in a gray stripe. Both turn black now, they're turned back on the very next frame whenever Pinterest grays them again, and they get the page's color back once nothing black is showing.
- Searching settings for AMOLED or dark theme now finds Black comments and Black pin menu as well as Black bottom bar. On a Pinterest build where one of the three can't be patched, the Interface page shows only the switches that work, each with its own description.
- Section headings in HushPinterest settings no longer pick up a dotted capital I ("SETTİNGS") when HushPinterest is set to English and Pinterest is in Turkish. Capitals now follow the language the heading is written in.
- The Support HushPinterest row at the bottom of settings is now just its name. The "Buy me a coffee on Ko-fi" line under it is gone, and the row still opens the Ko-fi page.

## Behind the scenes

- The gate's own dex checks find the pin menu's close event, the topic row and a lens built in place the way 14.40.0 lays them out, and the fixture tests pin 14.40.0's class names.
- The README is much shorter now. It keeps what you need to install, set up, troubleshoot and verify HushPinterest, and the longer version with its test notes and internals is still in the repository history. The Ko-fi link that dropped out of it on October 12 is back above the title.
- The help link on GitHub's new issue page now opens the README's Help section. It used to point at Discussions, which this repository doesn't have, so it led nowhere.
- Compiled APK checks cover settings requests delivered to Pinterest's home screen and reject a missing entry hook. Their small test APKs now include that activity too.
- The runtime reference now includes the original Pinterest 14.39.0 survey and four measurement intervals. It keeps those network counters and memory snapshots separate from the older 14.38.0 packet study. Four native settings screenshots were refreshed too, and the README's settings home picture now shows Quick setups and Report a problem.
- Compiled APK checks now cover what Hide save toasts writes for the board picker's toast, and they hold the save toasts flag to every kind of confirmation the patch looks for. A build without one of AMOLED black's three surfaces is checked for the ones it has. Patching says so in its log when a build has no board picker confirmation it can tell apart.

## Reported issues

The reports this release changes something for.

- #7, embed settings into the app (@kyoyacchi). HushPinterest now has its own row in Pinterest's Settings list, next to the Morphe entry. You can also switch HushPinterest's own screens to English under HushPinterest language on the Pause, backup and diagnostics page while Pinterest stays in Turkish, and the headings no longer turn into "SETTİNGS" when you do. The issue stays open until it's confirmed on your phone.
- #8, bottom bar buttons stay gray with Black bottom bar on. Frosted glass buttons and the search pill go black with the bar now, and so do buttons Pinterest rebuilds after the bar first shows.
- #9, Hide save toasts stops working after a while. Hide save toasts now catches several confirmations it used to let through, like the Saved to your board message Pinterest switches to after a few saves in a row to the same board. If the toast still comes back after Pinterest sits open for a while, please say so on the issue, and turn on Debug logging so the log shows which toast it was.
- #10, AMOLED black for the comments and the pin menu. Black comments and Black pin menu are two new switches on the Interface page.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest **14.40.0**, version code **14408010**, as the universal APK, and patch it. It needs Android 10 or newer.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap **Forgot your password?** on Pinterest's login page to set one first.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

Already on HushPinterest? Skip steps 4 and 5. Patch 14.40.0 with the same key and install it over the one you have.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

## Validation

All 219 patch tests and 943 extension tests passed on this commit, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto a real Pinterest 14.40.0 APK with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 29 patches applied without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.9.json` records that result, the APK's hash and what patching changed in the app's manifest. A phone running these patches on Pinterest 14.40.0 was checked too. With Black bottom bar on, the bar, its buttons, the search pill and the band below them were pure black, and the comments page and a pin's menu went black to the bottom edge with their new switches. Saving a pin showed no toast, the logo long press and the HushPinterest row in Pinterest's Settings both opened HushPinterest settings, and Visit site opened in the phone's browser.
